prompt:
Use the attached APPROVED Forest Egg concept sheet as a STRICT ART STYLE AND BODY CONSTRUCTION reference only. Create ONE NEW LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 pet concept sheet for the egg described below. Exactly FIVE different full-body pets, THREE cells across top row and TWO centered cells below. Same generous spacing, consistent core body size, same soft cream page, subtle themed tinted cell backgrounds, dark readable rounded typography, cute plastic 3D shading, soft contact shadows, front three-quarter view. Large dark title at top. Each cell has pet name then rarity centered below. NO percentages anywhere.
CRITICAL USER REQUIREMENTS: EVERY pet has ONE SQUARE CUBE base combining head and body, broad flat square front, flat top and sides, straight edges with small soft bevels. Face is directly ON cube front. NO separate head, neck, organic torso, projecting muzzle or spherical body. Four tiny stubby feet attach directly underneath each cube. All eyes oversized colored irises with white catchlights, low on face, tiny mouth, blush. Keep approved gentle softness. Designs must be SIMPLE: no leaves, floral collars, jewelry, tiny patterns, texture noise, particle storms or complicated layered appendages. One or two bold defining secondary forms per species. No realistic fur/scales/feathers. Tiny incidental markings flat on body. Rarity increases via obvious silhouettes and restrained luminous accents rather than detail clutter. All five read as different species, not palette swaps. All wings, tails, horns stay inside their cell; all captions legible. No actual eggs, football props, environment, watermark or added interface. Do NOT copy any of the Forest pets into the new sheet.

Title exactly: "FROST EGG".
Palette: ivory, icy blue, muted periwinkle; pale ice-blue cell panels.
Top left "SNOW PUP" / "COMMON": warm white cube puppy, two short floppy pale-blue ears, ice-blue eyes, simple little curled white tail, tiny grey nose. Minimal starter.
Top center "SNOWY PENGUIN" / "UNCOMMON": deep navy-blue cube penguin, flat white face/belly patch, amber eyes, small orange triangle beak, two smooth short side flippers, four tiny orange feet.
Top right "GLACIER WALRUS" / "RARE": pale turquoise cube walrus, huge friendly blue eyes, tiny dark nose, two SHORT smooth ivory tusks below mouth, two flat whisker dots per cheek, tiny side flippers and four compact flipper-shaped feet. Cube is the entire body; no separate rounded muzzle.
Bottom left "AURORA LYNX" / "EPIC": periwinkle cube lynx, tall softly triangular ears with ONE cyan ear tuft each, flat cream cheek patch, teal eyes, short broad blue tail with one luminous mint tip, tiny lavender feet. Only 3 simple darker spots on visible side, no aurora ribbons or sparkles.
Bottom right "GLACIER DRAGON" / "LEGENDARY": icy cyan cube dragon, enormous soft violet eyes, two smooth backward-swept ice horns, one pair of broad SIMPLE translucent blue crystal-shaped wings and a short curved tail with one broad ice tip. Two horns and wings carry the premium silhouette; restrained blue edge glow, no crystal clusters, no necklace, no body textures.
